description: Zones réglementées du Plan de Prévention des Risques d'Inondation de LOIRE ENTRE BARRAGE GRANGENT ET VEAUCHETTE (St-Just-st-Rambert, Andrézieux-Bouthéon, Bonson, St-Cyprien, Veauche, Veauchette) - Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.datara.gouv.fr. Risk prevention plans (RPPs) are the State's key instrument for risk prevention. Their objective is to control development in areas at risk. The development of a risk prevention plan generates a set of spatial data organised into several datasets including a spatial dataset of the restricted areas of the plan once approved. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Regulated areas of the Flood Risk Prevention Plan of LOIRE BETWEEN GRANGENT BARRAGE AND VEAUCHETTE (St-Just-st-Rambert, " (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include risque, Loire, Zones à risque naturel. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
